justification.max_input_bytes: The CVE is a per-operation cost that grows with the number of connection IDs already registered (each one a separate client Initial packet), so the harm is quadratic in the number of registrations; at 1-21 bytes per encoded connection ID, 10,240 bytes allow only about a thousand registrations, which finish in milliseconds even on the vulnerable version. Exceeding 20 s needs on the order of 10^5 registrations, i.e. close to 1 MB of input.
